english.note: Use this for the more general idea of being favored by fortune, especially in formal or written contexts.
Use this for the direct sense of being fortunate, especially in more formal wording or compounds.

examples.english: I feel very fortunate to have this opportunity.
examples.traditional: 能夠獲得呢個機會，我感到非常幸運。
examples.jyutping: nang4 gau3 wok6 dak1 ni1 go3 gei1 wui6 ngo5 gam2 dou3 fei1 soeng4 hang6 wan6

examples.english: I feel very lucky to be able to take part in this project.
examples.traditional: 能夠參與呢項計劃，我感到非常幸運。
examples.jyutping: nang4 gau3 caam1 jyu4 ni1 hong6 gai3 waak6 ngo5 gam2 dou3 fei1 soeng4 hang6 wan6
